title: Cost Catalog Writer Permission Consistency

items.action: open and submit category creation without requiring category read
update visible categories when category read also makes records selectable
delete visible categories when category read also makes records selectable
list cost products and read product category options
load supporting category options and create products without requiring product read
load supporting category options and update visible products when product read makes records selectable
delete visible products when product read makes records selectable

database.reason: No persistence model or database schema change is introduced.

migration.reason: All consumed permission codes already exist in Core.

audit.reason: Supporting category-option reads are non-mutating; existing create/update/delete audit behavior is unchanged.

notes: Cost Catalog read permissions continue to control category/product lists. Category and product create permissions can independently expose their create flows. Existing Admin navigation is permission-aligned rather than newly introduced. The supporting product category-options endpoint accepts product read, create, or update because all three workflows require the same organization-scoped lookup, while the normal product list remains products.read-only. Tenant-scoped query behavior remains unchanged and is covered by the required tenant-isolation gate. Existing CRUD permission codes and Core catalog semantics are unchanged.
